papers.title: WeMM-Embedding: WeChat Multi-Modal Embedding Technical Report
papers.authors: Junjie Zhou, Ke Mei, Lei Li, Tianyi Wang et al.
papers.summary: WeMM-Embedding is a family of universal multimodal embedding models that align text, images, videos, and interleaved inputs in a shared space, achieving state-of-the-art retrieval and recommendation performance across public benchmarks and large-scale WeChat applications.

papers.title: AutoSaddler: Automatic Harness Optimization with Durable Updates from Agent Execution Traces
papers.authors: Sungho Park, Wonjoong Kim, Rongyuan Tan, Jue Zhang et al.
papers.summary: AutoSaddler automatically improves LLM agent harnesses via offline failure-driven optimization, boosting performance on long-horizon benchmarks.

papers.title: On-Policy Self-Distillation in Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Wei Zhou, Xiongwei Zhu, Lingdong Kong, Bo Chen et al.
papers.summary: DiffusionOPSD uses on-policy self-distillation to turn image-level rewards into explicit intermediate targets for diffusion models, improving alignment efficiency and enabling separate analysis of target construction and policy fitting.

papers.title: Recursive Experiential-Working Memory Evolution for Long-Horizon Agent Harnesses
papers.authors: Zhaochen Yu, Yingcheng Wu, Zhenfei Yin, Kaiyuan Chen et al.
papers.summary: Recuris introduces a recursive memory architecture that tracks progress and guides skill selection to improve long-horizon agent success through localized, validation-gated updates.

papers.title: From Seeing to Acting: Smart Glasses as First-Person Intelligence Platforms
papers.authors: Jiangning Zhang, Haojun Chen, Yong Liu
papers.summary: Smart glasses are surveyed as unified first-person intelligence platforms requiring sustained perception-state-interaction-action loops across constrained hardware and diverse applications.

papers.title: On-policy Distillation with Verifiable Reward
papers.authors: Wenze Lin, Jiale Zhao, Xitai Jiang, Songde Rao et al.
papers.summary: OPDVR integrates on-policy distillation with verifiable rewards via a ReLU-gated implicit reward reformulation, improving reasoning performance without extra hyperparameters.

papers.title: Best Practice Critic Optimization
papers.authors: Penghui Qi, Xiangxin Zhou, Wee Sun Lee
papers.summary: BPCO stabilizes critic-based reinforcement learning for language models by combining bounded value predictions, Monte Carlo targets, and adaptive advantage estimation, matching group-based methods with single-response sampling.

papers.title: CAFE: Self-Improving Search Agents Need Co-Evolving Feedback
papers.authors: Boyang Liu, Senjie Jin, Peixin Wang, Zhangyue Yin et al.
papers.summary: CAFE couples a search agent and critic via shared parameters to learn in-trajectory corrective feedback, improving search performance and reducing hallucinations across benchmarks.

papers.title: LAION-BVD: A 10-Million-Hour Open Video Dataset for Multimodal Pre-training
papers.authors: Andreas Hochlehnert, Marianna Nezhurina, Mehdi Cherti, Andrej Radonjic et al.
papers.summary: LAION-BVD is a large-scale open video dataset enabling multimodal pre-training across video, audio, and image modalities with synthetic captions and strong benchmark performance.

papers.title: Length-Adaptive Decoding for Masked Diffusion Machine Translation
papers.authors: Yan Zhan, Mengkai Hou, Wanting Zhang, Zhijun Gao
papers.summary: Entropy-Valley selects target lengths for masked diffusion translation by scoring predictive entropy, improving adequacy and showing length choice matters more than unmasking order.

papers.title: Apodex 1.1: Scaling Agentic Intelligence for Complex Work
papers.authors: Apodex Team, B. An, B. Li, B. Wang et al.
papers.summary: Apodex 1.1 improves sustained, verifiable progress on complex real-world tasks by scaling executable environments and training agents to coordinate long-horizon work with state maintenance and recovery.

papers.title: EchoWM: Open and Enterable Omnimodal World Models
papers.authors: Songchun Zhang, Yaowei Li, Junhao Zhuang, Weiyang Jin et al.
papers.summary: EchoWM is an omnimodal world model that generates synchronized high-resolution video, sound, music, and speech while following continuous 6-DoF navigation trajectories across first- and third-person views.

papers.title: TLive-Omni: An Omni-Modal Understanding Model for E-Commerce Live Streaming
papers.authors: Yibo Hu, Yu Qian, Mao Gu, Yingfan Tao et al.
papers.summary: TLive-Omni is an omni-modal model for live-commerce that unifies image, video, audio, and text via timestamped token grouping, staged supervised training, and reinforcement fine-tuning with verifiable feedback to enable accurate real-time understanding.

papers.title: Unlocking the Potential of Image Editing via Concept Scaling and Dense Supervision
papers.authors: Long Cui, Xiaoqian Liu, Qi Qin, Yi Xin et al.
papers.summary: A hierarchical taxonomy and dense supervision strategy improve diffusion-based image editing through fine-grained concepts, large-scale paired data, and granular evaluation.

papers.title: MobilePA-Bench: Benchmarking Mobile Planner Agents on Complex Real-World Tasks
papers.authors: Yi Zhu, Xiongwei Wu, Qiyi Wang, Tingyu Qu et al.
papers.summary: MobilePA-Bench is an interactive sandbox benchmark that evaluates mobile planning agents on tool-calling, sub-agent collaboration, memory usage, and composite skill invocation under real runtime constraints.

papers.title: Prime Agent: A Self-Improving RLM Harness
papers.authors: Seth Karten, Alex L. Zhang, Kevin Thomas, Sebastian Müller et al.
papers.summary: Prime Agent is an open-source harness that uses recursive subagents, persistent computation, and agent-to-agent coordination to extend language models' long-horizon capabilities across coding and reasoning tasks.

papers.title: The Mask Is Not the Model: Auditing Prefix Invariance in Attention, State-Space, and Hybrid Sequence Models
papers.authors: Taebong Kim, Youngsik Hong, Minsik Kim, Sunyoung Choi et al.
papers.summary: The study proposes a lightweight audit to detect causality violations in sequence models by verifying prefix invariance, revealing that attention-mask checks miss leaks from scans or normalization.

papers.title: Block3D: Efficient Text-to-3D Generation via Block-Wise Diffusion
papers.authors: Bowen Cui, Weijie Wang, Zeyu Zhang, Yefei He et al.
papers.summary: Block3D accelerates text-to-3D generation by using block-wise diffusion with confidence-guided correction to reduce inference time while preserving geometric fidelity.

papers.title: Towards a Densing Law for User Representation Learning at Billion-Scale Capacity
papers.authors: Bin Dou, Junru Zhang, Zhaoyi Yuan, Wuliang Huang et al.
papers.summary: The study proposes a scaling law linking data size to tokenization capacity for user behavior modeling and introduces an adaptive tokenization method to improve efficiency.

papers.title: RISE: Adaptive Imagination for World Action Models
papers.authors: Hongbo Lu, Liang Yao, Chenghao He, Hao Han et al.
papers.summary: RISE adaptively decides when to continue or stop imagination rollouts for planning by weighing expected benefit against cost, supported by a counterfactual driving dataset with expert annotations.

papers.title: Graph Engineering in the Era of LLM Agents: From Individual Intelligence to System Intelligence
papers.authors: Yuyuan Feng, Zhishang Xiang, Chaobin Yang, Qichao Ma et al.
papers.summary: Graph Engineering organizes multi-agent LLM systems through dynamic graph structures to coordinate specialized agents and manage complex, evolving tasks.

papers.title: Let's Scale Step by Step: Compute-Efficient Hyperparameter Transfer for Large-Scale Mixture-of-Experts
papers.authors: Nayeon Kim, Hojin Lee, Yunju Bak, Jaesun Park et al.
papers.summary: A two-step hyperparameter transfer framework predicts optimal learning rates for large Mixture-of-Experts models by scaling across widths and token budgets, enabling efficient pretraining without costly sweeps.

papers.title: InfinityEdit: Infinite Video Editing with a Lightweight Edit-Ignition Adapter
papers.authors: Yunze Tong, Mushui Liu, Canyu Zhao, Shiyi Zhang et al.
papers.summary: InfinityEdit enables continuous, unbounded video editing by using a lightweight adapter with history, temporal causal, and edit cross-attention modules to extend edits into future streaming frames while maintaining stability.

papers.title: ParaTempo: Efficient Parallel Reasoning via Temporal Confidence
papers.authors: Xuteng Zhang, Wenhao Zeng, Xiaodong Gu, Chao Hu et al.
papers.summary: ParaTempo improves parallel reasoning efficiency by using temporal confidence to dynamically prune, retire, and reallocate reasoning branches without synchronization.

papers.title: Beyond Correctness: Benchmarking and Aligning Response Behaviors in Hybrid-Thinking MLLMs
papers.authors: Xinming Wang, Weinong Wang, Hongming Yang, Yansong Lin et al.
papers.summary: Hybrid-thinking multimodal language models suffer from response-pattern misalignment between thinking and non-thinking modes, which is addressed by a diagnostic benchmark and pattern-specific reinforcement learning penalties.

papers.title: OmniAssistBench: Assistant-style Interaction Benchmark for Omni-LLMs
papers.authors: Xianyun Sun, Chaoyou Fu, Zhengye Zhang, Feiyang Duan et al.
papers.summary: OmniAssistBench evaluates real-time interactive video assistants by reverse-engineering multi-turn interaction videos, revealing that current omni-modal models struggle with visual prompts, context retention, and timely responses.

papers.title: Every Coin Has Two Sides: On the Dual Nature of Generalization in On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models
papers.authors: Zhaoyi Li, Deyang Kong, Yuan Wei, Evan Yang et al.
papers.summary: On-policy distillation transfers reasoning behaviors rather than specific answers, with generalization strongly tied to teacher-student origin alignment and multi-teacher combinations causing capability trade-offs.

papers.title: WorldMind: Decoupled Game World Model for State-Aware NPC Behavior
papers.authors: Zhiyang Deng, Boran Zhang, Danze Chen, Yeying Jin
papers.summary: WorldMind decouples game world modeling into state understanding, decision-making, control, and generation layers to enable explicit, state-aware NPC behavior.

papers.title: EviRank: Structured Relevance Evidence for Multimodal Image Re-ranking
papers.authors: Enjun Du, Siyi Liu, Zirong Chen, Xinyu Zuo et al.
papers.summary: EviRank reformulates multimodal image re-ranking as semantic constraint satisfaction by parsing queries into structured evidence packages and verifying candidates via rubric scoring and listwise comparison without training.

papers.title: UniSpace: Unified Visual Representation and Scalable Multimodal Modeling
papers.authors: Jinbo Yan, Limeng Qiao, Jie Qin, Junyan He et al.
papers.summary: A reparameterized pretrained vision transformer unifies semantic understanding, high-fidelity reconstruction, and image generation within a single visual space without requiring a separate VAE.

papers.title: EnvHarness: Awakening Static Worlds for Agent Learning
papers.authors: Chengsong Huang, Zifeng Wang, Rujun Han, Jun Yan et al.
papers.summary: EnvHarness and EnvRigger dynamically reshape static environments via programmable plugins to target agent weaknesses and improve reinforcement learning co-evolution.

papers.title: FACET: Preserving Source Intent and Executable State in Terminal Task Synthesis
papers.authors: Kou Shi, Zun Wang, Qisheng Su, Shiting Huang et al.
papers.summary: FACET constructs executable terminal tasks by preserving source intent and grounding instructions, solutions, and verifiers in a shared repaired environment to enable scalable agent training.

papers.title: 4DAnyone: Create Anyone in 4D from a Casual Monocular Video
papers.authors: Yudong Jin, Tao Xie, Qihang Zhang, Zehong Shen et al.
papers.summary: 4DAnyone reconstructs 4D humans from monocular video by generating multiview-consistent videos and lifting them into 4D Gaussian Splatting, using reference and target context designs to overcome scaling bottlenecks.

papers.title: SWE-bench Science: Can Coding Agents Resolve Engineering Tasks in Science?
papers.authors: Zhipeng Xu, Jiahao Lu, Yining Zheng, Yuxin Wang et al.
papers.summary: SWE-bench Science benchmarks coding agents on scientific software repair, revealing failure mechanisms and mixed effects of scientific guidance.

papers.title: WithEveryone: Unified Planning and Identity Grounding for Group Image Generation
papers.authors: Hengyuan Xu, Qixun Wang, Yiji Cheng, Miles Yang et al.
papers.summary: WithEveryone enables reliable identity-preserving group image generation for up to ten people by grounding identities to layout plans and using region-based identity losses.

papers.title: MemTrapBench: Benchmarking Cognitive Traps in LLM Memory Use
papers.authors: Mengru Wang, Haozhe Luo, Zhenqian Xu, Zhixiang Cui et al.
papers.summary: Retrieved memories can induce reasoning errors and belief distortions in large language models, and an inference-time strategy helps avoid these cognitive traps while maintaining benchmark performance.

papers.title: SkillEvo: Self-Renewing Evolution Gradients from Multi-Turn Interaction Feedback
papers.authors: Qianxi Yan, Chunrong Chen, Jiuzhou Zhao, Min Zhang et al.
papers.summary: SkillEvo improves agent skills through multi-turn feedback and active governance to sustain evolution gradients.

papers.title: ForgeWM: Progressive Causal Training for Few-Step Action-Conditioned Video World Models
papers.authors: Xinye Li, Lingshuai Lin, Lei Wang, Liuzhou Zhang et al.
papers.summary: ForgeWM progressively distills bidirectional video generators into efficient few-step interactive world models with aligned discrete and continuous controls, supporting low-latency interaction and replay-time refinement.

papers.title: FlowEvo: Self-Evolving Agents through the Co-Evolution of Workflows and Executable Skills
papers.authors: Zeyu Ren, Ling Yue, Ran Li, Yishu Wang et al.
papers.summary: FlowEvo enables large language model agents to co-evolve reusable skills and workflows during inference, improving accuracy and efficiency across diverse benchmarks.

papers.title: Repo0: Design-Driven Zero-to-All Code Generation
papers.authors: Silin Chen, Haoyi Teng, Xiaodong Gu, Yuling Shi et al.
papers.summary: Repo0 uses a dual-graph architectural state and modularity-guided structural evolution to generate complete software repositories from natural-language requirements with high functionality coverage.

papers.title: SemComp-Bench: Benchmarking Semantic Task Completion in Video Generation
papers.authors: Keyu Tu, Zhuowei Chen, Mengqi Huang, Yuxin Wang et al.
papers.summary: Semantic task completion video generation evaluates whether generated videos achieve intended outcomes with semantic grounding, supported by a curated dataset and vision-language model-based benchmark.

papers.title: Zetta ζ: An Efficient Closed-Loop Embodied Harness for Self-Evolving Physical Intelligence
papers.authors: Xin Ding, Liang Mi, Mingzhe Huang, Zixuan Wang et al.
papers.summary: Zetta is a closed-loop embodied harness that evolves runtime critics and recovery skills online to govern physical execution at action frequency, achieving high success on robot benchmarks with faster inference and scaling self-exploration.

papers.title: SemaPLC: A Project-Grounded, Verification-Gated Agent Harness for PLC Code Generation
papers.authors: Yanlun Tu, Huacan Wang, Ziyue Zhou, Jie Zhou et al.
papers.summary: SemaPLC is a verification-gated agent harness that validates generated PLC logic through external compilation and live runtime execution, achieving higher verified pass rates than baseline methods.

papers.title: Co-RL: Unsupervised Reasoning Emerges from Diverse Cohort in Multi-agent RL
papers.authors: Yunhao Yang, Yuexin Bian, Yunjie Tian, Di Fu et al.
papers.summary: Co-RL enables unsupervised reasoning via cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning with peer-derived rewards, improving performance across text and vision tasks without ground-truth labels.

papers.title: OmniScientist: An Omni-Modal Omni-Discipline AI Scientist
papers.authors: Bobo Li, Hao Fei, Tianjie Ju, Mong-Li Lee et al.
papers.summary: OmniScientist is an end-to-end omni-modal AI scientist that performs multidisciplinary research directly from heterogeneous raw evidence using autonomous agents and lifecycle-wide perception, improving evidence-grounded discovery across diverse scientific modalities.

papers.title: SPADE: Self-Play in Adaptive Synthetic Executable Environments
papers.authors: Bo Liu, Simon Yu, Yiding Jiang, Ao Qu et al.
papers.summary: SPADE is a self-play reinforcement learning framework where a language model designs adaptive executable training environments and learns to solve them, improving reasoning and tool-use performance through regret-based environment targeting.

papers.title: Training Chemical Plausibility-Aware Large Language Models for Single-Step Retrosynthesis
papers.authors: Bogdan Zagribelnyy, Ivan Ilin, Nikita Bondarev, Maksim Kuznetsov et al.
papers.summary: Top-K prompting and plausibility-aware training improve diverse reaction prediction in single-step retrosynthesis, yielding state-of-the-art results on a large verified reaction dataset and motivating ensemble systems.

papers.title: FM-Bench: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Management with Competing Agents
papers.authors: Tianyou Wang, Chongyang Gao, Kezhen Chen, Chen Dong et al.
papers.summary: FM-Bench evaluates long-horizon decision-making of LLM agents managing a football club over 20 years, revealing that managerial behavior rather than scale or token spend drives performance.

papers.title: Training Leaves Traces: Centered Residual Signatures for Language Model Lineage Verification
papers.authors: Aman Singh Thakur, Rayan Khoury
papers.summary: Compatible open-weight language model checkpoints share detectable weight-space ancestry signals that distinguish true lineage from independent or distilled models without requiring data.

papers.title: Looped Language Models Improve Compositional Tool Calling
papers.authors: Andrei Cristian Popescu, Haitz Sáez de Ocáriz Borde, Pietro Liò
papers.summary: Looped language models improve compositional, multi-step tool use through recurrent computation, with adaptive inference balancing accuracy and compute cost.
